items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: And we have a contractor, Steve Trudell, out of Detroit, who actually contracts all the local strings for us throughout the country.

ctx.x: Yeah. And there’s no music on stage, right? And there’s no music stands?

There’s music stands for the string section, because seven of the strings would be local players. We take the lead violin player, who also runs all over the place on stage, you know they get to rock out. They memorize everything and they’re also the conductor- leader for the string section. So all the parts are written out. I made up all the scores and stuff for it. And they rehearse earlier in the day for the show and just play through it and go over the tough spots. And we have a contractor, Steve Trudell, out…
